title: Babul Murad Ghazi
body:
Shere khuda ke Dilbar Babul murad ghazi
Abbas ibne haidar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(1)
Bharti hai har bashar ki jholi thumare dar se
Mujh natawa’n pe tera abre karam jo barse
Guncha bane gule tar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(2)
Chaukhat pe teri maula aata hai jo sawali
Hargiz nahi palatta babe ata se khali
Kono maka’n ke sarwar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(3)
Do mustafa ka sadqa mushkil kusha ka sadqa
Maula hasan ka sadqa shahe hoda sadqa
Aye fatima ke dilbar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(4)
Chalta hai ab bhi sikka ghazi teri wafa ka
Isaar or shujaat padhti hai tera kalma
Sani e shere dawar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(5)
Saya tere Alam ka hai shaha ki aza par
Karte hain shae ka matam parcham tera utha kar
Sabro wafa ke mahewar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(6)
Taskeen e kalbe zainab kulsoom ka sahara
Tere wajood hi se thi mutmaeen sakeena
Aye aitebar e sarwar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(7)
Badli musibato’n ki har samt cha gayi hai
Be jurm ahele haq ko duniya sata rahi hai
Imdad kar do akar Babul murad ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
(8)
Zulmat mite Jaha’n se waqte zahoor aaye
Mahfooz noor e haq se kaunain jagmagaye
Paye sukoon khawar Babul murad ghazi
author: Maulana Khawar Sultanpuri
